name: appointments_180d
formula: count scheduled appointments in [landmark-179d, landmark] created by landmark
landmark_cutoff: only records whose effective/known timestamp is <= landmark_at

name: attended_appointment_count
formula: count prior appointments converted to service
landmark_cutoff: only records whose effective/known timestamp is <= landmark_at

name: no_show_rate
formula: prior no-show count / prior completed appointment count; 0 with no history
landmark_cutoff: only records whose effective/known timestamp is <= landmark_at

name: cancellation_rate
formula: prior cancellation count / prior completed appointment count; 0 with no history
landmark_cutoff: only records whose effective/known timestamp is <= landmark_at

name: successful_appointment_rate
formula: prior converted count / prior completed appointment count; 0 with no history
landmark_cutoff: only records whose effective/known timestamp is <= landmark_at

name: rebook_after_no_show_rate
formula: prior no-shows followed by a new appointment creation by landmark / prior no-shows
landmark_cutoff: only records whose effective/known timestamp is <= landmark_at

name: days_since_last_appointment
formula: landmark minus latest prior scheduled appointment date
landmark_cutoff: only records whose effective/known timestamp is <= landmark_at

name: known_open_appointment_count
formula: created by landmark and scheduled after landmark; outcome ignored
landmark_cutoff: only records whose effective/known timestamp is <= landmark_at

name: recent_no_show_without_rebook
formula: 1 when a no-show in prior 180d has no later creation by landmark
landmark_cutoff: only records whose effective/known timestamp is <= landmark_at

name: overdue_service_share
formula: share of completed services with positive recorded pre-service overdue days or km
landmark_cutoff: only records whose effective/known timestamp is <= landmark_at

name: prior_service_delay_median
formula: median service_delay_days over completed prior services
landmark_cutoff: only records whose effective/known timestamp is <= landmark_at

name: prior_service_delay_p90
formula: 90th percentile service_delay_days over completed prior services
landmark_cutoff: only records whose effective/known timestamp is <= landmark_at

name: last3_service_delay_trend
formula: OLS slope by order over the last three completed service delays
landmark_cutoff: only records whose effective/known timestamp is <= landmark_at

name: interservice_days_cv
formula: coefficient of variation of completed-service date gaps; 0 with <3 services
landmark_cutoff: only records whose effective/known timestamp is <= landmark_at

name: interservice_km_cv
formula: coefficient of variation of positive odometer gaps; 0 with <3 services
landmark_cutoff: only records whose effective/known timestamp is <= landmark_at

name: recency_weighted_adherence_score
formula: exp(-age/365)-weighted share with delay <= 0; 0.5 with no history
landmark_cutoff: only records whose effective/known timestamp is <= landmark_at

name: service_gap_acceleration

landmark_cutoff: only records whose effective/known timestamp is <= landmark_at

name: days_since_last_any_interaction

name: interaction_count_90d

name: interaction_count_180d
formula: appointment creations plus service deliveries in prior 180d
landmark_cutoff: only records whose effective/known timestamp is <= landmark_at

name: appointment_frequency_365d
formula: appointment creations in prior 365d
landmark_cutoff: only records whose effective/known timestamp is <= landmark_at

name: distinct_workshops_before_landmark
formula: distinct workshops across completed prior services
landmark_cutoff: only records whose effective/known timestamp is <= landmark_at

name: dominant_workshop_share
formula: largest completed-service workshop share; 0 with no history
landmark_cutoff: only records whose effective/known timestamp is <= landmark_at

name: same_workshop_streak
formula: consecutive completed services at the most recent workshop
landmark_cutoff: only records whose effective/known timestamp is <= landmark_at

name: recent_30d_km
formula: sum monthly km_added for observations ending in prior 30d
landmark_cutoff: only records whose effective/known timestamp is <= landmark_at

name: recent_180d_km
formula: sum monthly km_added for observations ending in prior 180d
landmark_cutoff: only records whose effective/known timestamp is <= landmark_at

formula: 30d daily km / 180d daily km; 0 when 180d km is zero

name: usage_volatility_6m

name: days_since_last_breakdown
formula: landmark minus latest completed breakdown
landmark_cutoff: only records whose effective/known timestamp is <= landmark_at

name: repeated_breakdown_flag
formula: 1 for at least two completed breakdowns in prior 365d
landmark_cutoff: only records whose effective/known timestamp is <= landmark_at
